_help: Travel pages, one entry per country. To add a country: copy an entry, set slug (URL: /marrow-washing-<slug>), name (English), lang (the language its own page is in: one of zh es fr de pt ru ja th ar hi it el, or en for English-speaking countries), local (the country's name in that language, plus 'in' = 'in <country>' when that language needs articles/cases: required for el, fr, pt, ru; optional elsewhere; see tools/country_templates.json 'rules'), and names (the country's name in all 12 languages, used in the list on the worldwide page), and optionally en_in for the English wording inside sentences when it differs from the name (e.g. name 'United Kingdom', en_in 'the United Kingdom'). Then run: python3 tools/build_country_pages.py --check && python3 tools/build_country_pages.py && python3 tools/build_lang_pages.py. A new country page is a new page: send it to the owner as a proposal PR.
